name: @galerina/tools-myco
description: grep, but it grows a graph — a graph-indexed search tool for file contents and filenames. Smart-case, token-precise, and instant on repeat searches.
author: TritHypha <hello@trithypha.dev>

divergenceReasons.src/cli.ts: Galerina retains the local Markdown-link command and imports the local-only links module.
divergenceReasons.src/query/path-filter.ts: Comments use the active Galerina packages-ts root; executable behavior remains source-owner compatible.
divergenceReasons.src/query/regex-guard.ts: Owner-requested 120-second total search budget, synchronized with the public source owner's local working copy. The pinned upstream snapshot still has five seconds; advance the snapshot only after the upstream change is committed. The 250 ms regex-operation deadline is unchanged.
divergenceReasons.src/query/links.ts: Galerina-only Markdown-link classification and repair extension.

galerinaVendor.rule: The public Myco repository owns shared code. Galerina divergence must remain explicit, tested and reproduced by audit; never overwrite either owner while claiming byte identity.
